variants.name: variant-v4-no-rules-or-commands
variants.description: V4 ablation: full donnyclaude install except .claude/rules/ AND .claude/commands/ are excluded. These two component classes are bundled into one ablation per the experiment design (rules and commands are both prescriptive textual guidance and likely interfere similarly). Used by ablation-django-13128 round to test whether rules+commands are responsible for the V4 regression on django__django-13128. Uses install_full_donnyclaude composite mutation with params.exclude=['rules','commands'].
